# Spec { #crossrepo.Spec }

```python
crossrepo.Spec(repo, path, owner=None, version=None)
```

A parsed reference to a result file.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

<code>[**repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository name.

<code>[**path**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Path within the repository, or a bare file name when that is unambiguous within the repository.

<code>[**owner**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository owner, needed only to disambiguate repositories of the same name in different organisations.

<code>[**version**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Commit sha prefix or tag name. `None` means the latest version.

## See Also {.doc-section .doc-section-see-also}

[](`crossrepo.core.resolve_one`)

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [parse](#crossrepo.Spec.parse) | Parse a spec string. |

### parse { #crossrepo.Spec.parse }

```python
crossrepo.Spec.parse(text)
```

Parse a spec string.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**text**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A string of the form ``[owner/]repo:path[@version]``.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [\'Spec\']{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The parsed spec.

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ValueError](`ValueError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If `text` does not have the expected form.

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
Spec.parse("munch-group/primate-ils:results/ils_data.h5@4e6472a")
Spec.parse("humanXsweeps:tmrca_stats.hdf")
```
